item.title: WATCH: Indian supporters taunt head coach with ‘Gautam Gambhir haaye haaye’ chants following devastating 2-0 series loss to South Africa
item.description: India head coach Gautam Gambhir faced intense criticism from fans following the devastating series loss against South Africa. South Africa delivered a historic 408-run victory to sweep the Test series 2-0 on Indian soil for the first time in 25 years.
